clips.title: The story
paras: Windfury Ridge looms over Mulgore’s pastures, where harpies nest among wolves and cougars. Its slopes threaten travelers, while tauren hunters prize the harpies’ feathers.

Windfury Ridge rises above Mulgore’s plains, where Windfury harpies nest among the crags. They swoop on wanderers who pass too close to the hills. Prairie wolves and mountain cougars prowl the rocky slopes, making this border of the tauren heartland dangerous. Tauren warriors hunt the harpies, whose iridescent feathers are sought in Thunder Bluff for ceremonial garments worn at feasts and weddings.
